profiles.name: generic_va_fald_miniled
profiles.description: Placeholder VA mini-LED FALD set. Contrast is high on axis and falls off quickly with angle. Zone grid and PSF are round numbers, not a zone map from a shipping set.

profiles.name: generic_ips_edge
profiles.description: Placeholder edge-lit IPS set. Native contrast is lower than VA, viewing angle is wider, and the backlight is a single row of segments whose light is spread by a wide PSF. Each segment drives a full-height column before the blur; that is a stand-in, not a light-guide simulation.

profiles.name: generic_woled
profiles.description: Placeholder WOLED. Emission is per pixel (no zone grid). The WRGB mosaic is energy-preserving when box-filtered, so it does not change a flat color. ABL pulls the allowed peak down toward the full-field figure as APL rises. Spectral white-subpixel mixing beyond that mosaic is not modeled.

profiles.name: generic_qdoled
profiles.description: Placeholder QD-OLED. The triangular subpixel buffer is a geometric stand-in that box-filters back to the source color. A little per-pixel PSF stands in for optical crosstalk. Quantum-dot spectra and a real gamut matrix are not modeled; color_matrix stays identity.

format.transfer: linear absolute channel intensities; neutral R=G=B=N represents N cd/m²
format.colorimetry_status: P preview interpretation: the simulator has synthetic RGB matrices, no calibrated gamut or spectral model
format.pq_source_note: Procedural RGB nits use PQ per-channel for pipeline input only; PQ transfer does not imply BT.2020 primaries.
format.presentation: No SDR exposure, OETF or per-TV normalization is baked into assets. Browser mapping is a separate transform.

temporal_protocol.history: One persistent response/load pipeline per profile; pre-roll holds the initial source, then frame i advances i*8 pixels with wrap.
temporal_protocol.observer: Synthetic horizontal pursuit integration; full hold, MEMC off; playback loop resets to the saved first frame.
temporal_protocol.loop_boundary: Not a continuous loop; response/load history jumps from the final saved frame to the first saved frame.
